svg.title: VarTrustML workflow
svg.desc: Animated loop with synthetic, illustrative values. Three short-read structural variant callers scan a stretch of chr1: MANTA and SMOOVE report deletion call A, only DELLY reports call B. The read pileup and its coverage track show split reads, discordant pairs, soft clips and a coverage drop at call A, a lens shows the soft-clipped bases at one breakpoint, and the evidence becomes a feature vector. Six models (CatBoost, XGBoost, Random Forest, MLP, Logistic Regression, KNN) are compared under nested cross-validation against the callers with McNemar and DeLong tests and Holm correction, and ranked. The best model is calibrated, tested on every train and test pair of HG002, NA12878 and REACH and with leave-one-dataset-out, next to the feature shift between datasets, and its calibrated probability, against the Youden threshold, marks call A true and call B false, with SHAP attributions and the rows written to predictions.csv.
